2577-5231-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5231-6664-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3899-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

631-4247-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4247-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2201-2558-5687-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2201-2558-5687-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

206-222-527-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-6461--5.easyPrerequisites: Warden of the Grove has a counter on it.
728-6461--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

483-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

252-4231-4359-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-4359-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

833-3257-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-3257-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Rakdos Carnarium, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2613-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Spiteful Sliver to take damage.
2613-5166--86.description:
Cause Spiteful Sliver to take damage by any method.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Repeat from step 2.

6566-6798--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6566-6798--5--195.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1032-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Power of Fire by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

560-1563-3899-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5256-6972-7726.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7509.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2335-2760-7503.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Barrenton Medic +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

141-7063.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-7063.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
141-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ember Island Production, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Ember Island Production, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
997-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

2770-5147-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1829-2173-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2014-2034-3055.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

2457-3499-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1848-6285.notablePrerequisites:
Fleet Swallower does not have summoning sickness.
You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
1848-6285.description:
Declare Fleet Swallower as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing a player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus causing the player targeted by Fleet Swallower's ability to mill the remainder of their library.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2438-2533-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1548-5658.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker.
Satya triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer that is tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage using the Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-2281-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lurrus enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1558-1908-2567-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
1558-1908-2567-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Avenger of Zendikar with haste.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Avenger of Zendikar token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1017-1242-1656-3795.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Ally.
1017-1242-1656-3795.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Sea Gate Loremaster's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

262-1634-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Freed from the Real attached to Devilish Valet.
Any amount of
262-1634-4222.description:
Activate Devilish Valet by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, doubling Devilish Valet's power until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Devilish Valet.
Repeat as desired, or as {U} persists.

280-1530-3293.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
280-1530-3293.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Golgari Rot Farm from your hand.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
